crossRefs.note: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

translations.web: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
translations.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
